ann.t: Press Release — Union Bank of India has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated October 19, 2026, titled "Press Release on the Financial Results of the Bank for the Quarter ended on September 30, 2026".
Outcome of Board Meeting — Union Bank of India has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.

Press Release — Union Bank of India has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated July 15, 2026, titled "Press Release on the Financial Results of the Bank for the Quarter ended on June 30, 2026.".
Outcome of Board Meeting — Union Bank of India has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended Jun 30, 2026.

Cessation — Union Bank of India has informed the Exchange regarding Cessation of Mr Sanjay Rudra as Executive Director of the company w.e.f. July 01, 2026, on completion of his  tenure on 30th June 2026.

Press Release (Revised) — Union Bank of India has informed the Exchange regarding a revised press release dated April 23, 2026, titled "Press Release on the Financial Results of the Bank for the Quarter/Year ended on March 31, 2026.".

Press Release — Union Bank of India has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated April 23, 2026, titled "Press Release on the Financial Results of the Bank for the Quarter/Year ended on March 31, 2026".
Outcome of Board Meeting — Union Bank of India has submitted to the Exchange Audited Financial Results (Standalone and Consolidated) of the Bank for the Quarter/Year ended March 31, 2026.
Cessation — Union Bank of India has informed the Exchange regarding Cessation of Mr Shri Suraj Srivastava as Non- Executive Independent Director of the company w.e.f. April 11, 2026.

General Updates — Union Bank of India has informed the Exchange about Fund raising through issue of Long-Term Bonds for financing of infrastructure & affordable housing of ₹7,500 crore (Base issue size of ₹3,000 Crore and Green shoe option of ₹4,500 Crore)
Updates — Union Bank of India has informed the Exchange regarding 'Outcome of the Meeting of the Committee of Directors for fund raising (Non-Capital) held on March 16, 2026'.
Cessation — Union Bank of India has informed the Exchange regarding Cessation of Mr Avinash Vasant Prabhu as Chief Financial Officer of the company w.e.f. February 01, 2026.

Press Release — Union Bank of India has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated January 14, 2026, titled "Press Release on the Financial Results of the Bank for the Third Quarter/Nine Months ended on December 31, 2025".
Outcome of Board Meeting — Union Bank of India has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended December 31, 2025.
Cessation — Union Bank of India has informed the Exchange regarding Cessation of Mr Srinivasan Varadarajan as Chairman of the company w.e.f. November 07, 2025.
